Project Manager

transitions, and digital strategy. Proven track record of leading high-impact programs ($100M+), managing cross-functional teams, and winning strategic

raw_sections.experience:
EXPERIENCE
Grant Thornton Bharat LLP
Aug '22 - Present
Manager
Spearheaded global risk and broking transformation programs across North America, EMEA, and APAC, delivering $101M+ cost savings through
operating model redesign and digital enablement.
Managed enterprise transformation initiatives involving cross-functional teams across technology, operations, risk, and business functions. • Directed end-to-end core banking implementation and data migration for an Urban Cooperative Bank covering 17 branches with zero business disruption.
Governed UAT, vendor management, parallel run execution, and risk mitigation, improving operational efficiency by 20%. • Managed ESG transformation initiatives for the Corporate & Investment Banking (CIB) division at HSBC Holdings plc, supporting ESG data ingestion and governance for the HSBC Utility Project.
Coordinated business and technology stakeholders to streamline ESG data integration, validation, and reporting processes. • Led RFP response strategy and proposal development for banking and financial services clients, reducing proposal turnaround time by 30% through reusable frameworks and accelerators.
Designed operating models and strategic roadmaps for digital-first financial services initiatives, improving lending opportunity identification by 20%. • Implemented KPI–OKR–KRA frameworks, improving productivity by 15%.
Oct '16 - Apr '22
Allianz Services Pvt Ltd
Deputy Manager
Led a 68-member operations team with 3 deputy managers for policy administration in Entertainment Insurance, improving operational efficiency
by 25% through effective planning and workload management.
Managed process excellence initiatives using process mapping, Lean Six Sigma, and Kaizen to track progress, mitigate risks, and improve quality
across operations.
Developed phased transition plans covering knowledge transfer, reverse shadowing, parallel run, and operational stabilization. • Built and executed transition blueprints and capacity plans from KT to BAU for the US Entertainment portfolio, ensuring a smooth go-live and stable operations.
Revamped underwriting support workflows and deployed automation solutions using Blue Prism and UiPath, reducing turnaround time for high-
premium policies by 20%.
Streamlined lean operating models by eliminating non-value-added activities and aligning KPIs to business goals. • Successfully managed and closed multiple internal and client process audits by ensuring adherence to compliance standards, strengthening process controls, and driving timely closure of audit observations with zero critical escalations.
Apr '12 - Jul '16
AXA Business Services Pvt Ltd
Project Lead Specialist
Spearheaded the end-to-end transition and transformation of claims operations from Singapore, including project planning, knowledge transfer, and
process redesign, achieving a 20% efficiency gain and 20% reduction in processing time.
Supported activity mapping, process documentation, and gap analysis during transition readiness assessments. • Assisted in FTE estimation and productivity benchmarking for new service lines. • Instituted SOPs and controls that improved claim registration accuracy by 15%, strengthened fraud-risk verification, and ensured SLA compliance. • Guided a team of 11 analysts in refining resource allocation and shift planning, achieving a 15% reduction in TCO. • Mentored team members to improve quality and reduce error rates by 12%. • Developed performance dashboards to track TAT, SLA breaches, and client satisfaction, resulting in a 7% increase in client satisfaction (NPS).
KPMG
May '11 - Mar '12
Analyst • Conducted end-to-end verification of business entities using ROC, TAN, GST, and domain registration databases to assess legitimacy and identify
fraudulent or shell companies.
Performed employee background verification and professional conduct assessments, supporting clients in informed hiring and risk evaluation
decisions.
Analyzed work ethic, behavioral patterns, strengths, and development areas through structured profiling and verification processes. • Prepared audit-ready compliance reports by consolidating findings from multiple verification sources in line with KPMG quality and documentation standards.
